name: Americano, Please!
original_name: アメリカーノ、プリーズ！
source:
Main character helps around coffee shop where his sister works. The cafe becomes popular, and he explores opportunity to work there full-time after graduation. One day he learns that his sister considers an invitation to take the manager position in the different prefecture thus breaking them apart...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在姐姐工作的咖啡店里帮忙。咖啡店日益受欢迎，他也开始考虑毕业后留在这里全职工作。然而有一天，他得知姐姐正在考虑接受邀请，前往其他县担任店长，这将令两人从此分隔两地…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
